My plot is very small, just a little piece of land where I plant my cassava and cocoyam for the family to eat. I am an old woman now, 64 years, so I cannot do heavy work like before, but my children and grandchildren help me small small. I cannot afford to buy chemical fertilizer for such a small plot, but I will put the compound waste and goat droppings from the house on the soil like we have always done. I plant the stems from last year's cassava, and because rain falls plenty here in the South South, I do not need to fetch water for it.
